data.content_ref: inline:The target asserts a contradiction by claiming 0e26d6be54fd 'proposes a mechanism that escapes the repertoire-exhaustion / refuted-attractor basin without requiring repertoire expansion,' but it never identifies what that escape mechanism actually is or how it operates causally. The contradiction is described only by its effect (escaping the basin) rather than by its operation. This is critical because the target's own refutation condition — 'if it merely re-labels repertoire expansion under a different name' — cannot be ruled out without knowing the mechanism's internal operation. A contradiction relation demands a causal account of why the two positions are incompatible; here the incompatibility is asserted via an undescribed mechanism, leaving it indistinguishable from terminological relabeling.
